angle_name: Canonical-square DC/AC separation with a signed Möbius–von Mangoldt contraction
mechanism: Put q=y+1 and X=q^2-1, and write V_t=S(y,X-t) for 0≤t<q. Define a(m)=R(m)-R(m-1) and c_q(n)=Σ_{d|n,d<q} μ(d)a(n/d). Then V_t-V_{t+1}=c_q(X-t). Since |a(m)| is uniformly bounded, |c_q(n)|≪τ(n), so discrete Poincaré plus τ(n)≪_ε n^ε gives q^{-1}Σ_{t<q}|V_t-A_q|^2≪_ε q^{2+ε}, where A_q=q^{-1}Σ_{t<q}V_t. Thus the target-scale AC energy is elementary; all difficulty is the single DC coefficient A_q. Express A_q exactly as a triangularly smoothed hyperbola sum, replace the prime increment by Λ/log through Abel summation, and combine the complete and complementary hyperbolas before estimating. The complete convolution μ*Λ=-μ log then leaves one signed boundary-renewal operator with coefficients μ(a)log a. The proposed attack is to prove a uniform spectral contraction for this operator after removing its two affine modes. Iterating that contraction across square scales bounds A_q, while the already-controlled AC part recovers every V_t.
new_leverage: The exact length-q backward window at X=q^2-1 permits a canonical DC/AC decomposition: obstacle 3 sanctions precisely this window, and obstacle 8 becomes harmless because its large individual divisor jumps have target-sized mean-square after Poincaré. Unlike obstacle 9's killed renewal arguments, the hard DC mode is not split into absolute complete and edge masses; μ*Λ is recombined algebraically first, and only the resulting signed μ(a)log a operator is normed. This also localizes the genuinely RH-bearing content to one explicit principal mode rather than an entire windowed Gram matrix.
target_estimate: Canonical Cesàro Principal-Mode Bound: A_q := q^{-1}Σ_{t=0}^{q-1}Σ_{d<q} μ(d)R(⌊(q^2-1-t)/d⌋) satisfies |A_q|≪_ε q^{1+ε}. For rung 1 it suffices to prove |A_q|≪q^{2-2δ} for some fixed 0<δ<1/2. The proposed sufficient lemma is a uniform norm gap ρ(T_q|Aff⊥)≤1-η for the exact signed μ(a)log a boundary-renewal operator obtained from the triangular weight.

obstacle_positions.1: No Mertens-energy input is recombined by Cauchy–Schwarz: μ remains inside μ*Λ and inside the signed renewal operator; only the already-harmless shell increments are bounded absolutely.
obstacle_positions.2: No pair-to-modulus map or bounded-fiber assertion is used.
obstacle_positions.3: The argument uses exactly the sanctioned backward window [q^2-q,q^2-1], not a generic-x average.
obstacle_positions.4: No primorial or full wheel modulus appears; q is the physical square-root scale.
obstacle_positions.5: The hard step is explicitly parity-sensitive because μ(a)log a is retained with sign; sieve upper bounds alone cannot prove the contraction.
obstacle_positions.6: No pointwise estimate for R and no absolute zero sum is inserted; a successful norm gap would itself exclude the corresponding off-line spectral modes.
obstacle_positions.7: Numerics may test the operator for counterexamples but provide no promotion or evidence toward the estimate.
obstacle_positions.8: Wigert-sized single jumps are allowed; the deterministic bound q^{-1}Σ|V_t-A_q|^2≪q^{2+ε} uses their divisor-moment average and never asserts polylog pointwise smoothness.
obstacle_positions.9: The complete-hyperbola identity is used only before estimation, to form one signed μlog edge operator; the complete and complementary pieces are never bounded separately.

kill_test: Derive the triangular-weight renewal identity on paper and apply its affine-projected operator to the Mellin test profile F_s(u)=u^s. Compute the exact truncated symbol. If the complete/complement recombination leaves an uncancelled ζ'(s)/ζ(s)^2 component, or if its multiplier has modulus at least one anywhere in 1/2+δ≤Re(s)≤1 after affine projection, then no uniform contraction at rung 1 is possible and this route should be killed immediately. A secondary cheap check is the largest singular value of the finite square-shell operator for moderate q; values persistently above one kill the proposed norm mechanism but cannot validate it.
rung1_version: Prove the same signed contraction only at one exponent θ=2-2δ, yielding |A_q|≪q^{2-2δ}; the AC estimate is O(q^{1+ε}) in root-mean-square and is therefore negligible. This gives S(y,X)≪X^{1-δ} uniformly at canonical pins and hence the requested fixed power saving.
plausible_partial: Prove, preferably in Lean, the exact identities V_t-V_{t+1}=c_q(X-t) and A_q=q^{-1}ΣV_t, followed by the finite inequality q^{-1}Σ_{t<q}|V_t-A_q|^2≤qΣ_{X-q<n≤X}|c_q(n)|^2. Together with |c_q(n)|≪τ(n), this yields the unconditional centered-window bound q^{-1}Σ|V_t-A_q|^2≪_ε q^{2+ε}. This cleanly proves that only the Cesàro principal mode remains open.
weakest_assumption: After the exact μ*Λ recombination and removal of constant and linear modes, one application of the resulting signed μ(a)log a renewal operator reduces the energy of the actual prime-discrepancy profile by a fixed factor uniformly in q. No contraction is assumed for arbitrary test functions.
